name: Arboria Survivalist
text:
Whenever you activate an artifact's activated ability, exile it.
Whenever this creature attacks, create a token that's a copy of a card exiled with it.
{1}, Sacrifice an artifact: This creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
flavorText: "With the correct bionic combination, the Extinction can do me no harm."

name: Armored Regent
text:
Trample, lifelink
Whenever this creature attacks, put a stun counter on it.
Requiem — For as long as this creature is tapped, whenever one or more cards enter or leave your graveyard, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.
flavorText: Some Dinokind work alongside humans to prevent the devastation of the Extinction.

name: Calamity Twins
text:
When this creature enters, if it's not a token, create a token that's a copy of it.
Whenever you sacrifice a permanent, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
flavorText: Dinokind twins are an exceedingly rare phenomenon. Those born as twins are said to embody life after the Extinction and are both feared and revered.

name: Citadel Preacher
text:
Flying
Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature. Third spell, untap up to two target lands you control, and fourth spell, draw two cards.
flavorText: "Humanity and Dinokind must sing as one. Join, tiny one, your voice matters."

name: Cosmoceraptos
text:
Flash
You may cast enchantment spells as though they had flash.
Whenever this creature attacks, the next spell you cast this turn has affinity for enchantments.
flavorText: Behold, a vision of a broken world: one is swallowed by silent oblivion, while the other wails to the stars and beyond.

name: Jagged-Teeth Bringer
text:
This creature can't be blocked.
Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, that player discards a card and you draw a card.
flavorText: A Bringer's bite gives visions of life after the Extinction. Some go mad; others live in pure bliss.

name: Living Driveway
text: Each creature you control with toughness greater than its power crews Vehicles using its toughness rather than its power and assigns combat damage equal to its toughness rather than its power.
flavorText: These gentle dinokind do not see themselves as above humans, but as part of a vibrant ecosystem where everyone has their role and place to contend with.

name: Realm Chomper
text:
Vigilance, trample
Whenever this creature enters, goad target creature you don't control.
Whenever this creature kills a creature, create a Treasure token.
flavorText: "The Extinction begins when I say it does — and I'm not in a merciful mood."

name: Shepherd of the Extinction
text:
When this creature enters, you get an emblem with "Whenever a creature dies, target opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life."
At the beginning of your upkeep, you may destroy all creatures.
flavorText: "Who in willing of body and mind? Let us walk, unafraid! As one!"

name: Wisened Stomper
text:
Prowess
Whenever you cast a noncreature spell while this creature is attacking, choose one —
• Tap target creature and put a stun counter on it.
• Untap target creature and put a +1/+1 counter on it.
flavorText: The Wiseneds manipulate the world so the Extinction will occur. Some prefer to do it from above.
